programme.title: ABBA樂團: 歐洲歌唱大賽後的半世紀
programme.desc: 從頭記錄ABBA由歐洲歌唱大賽到崛起成全球巨星、他們標誌性的嗓音、破紀錄的成功、單飛的努力、ABBA精選唱片- Gold的復甦,以及先進的全息投影巡演- 《啟航》,樂隊以虛擬形式重聚。

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森: 誘惑的藝術
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峯。

programme.desc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到托斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 海賊王 #489
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #2
programme.desc: 離春高全國大賽僅剩一個月。擅自參加宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的日向以撿球員的身分加入。此時白鳥澤3年級生的畢業生作為練習賽的對手來訪。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #3
programme.desc: 日向・影山・月島不在的情況下,烏野高中排球社面臨與常波高中的練習賽。與此同時,至今只一味追趕球的日向從外觀摩和牛島等人的練習賽時,首次發現一件事。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #9
programme.desc: 阿貝爾回想著少年時期的回憶。他那時因王族末弟的身分被周遭冷眼相待,低調過活。某天他在庭園遇見不可思議的少女海倫娜。隨著共度越多美好時光,雖然深厚的愛情在兩人間慢慢滋長。此刻菲娜與傷勢好轉的雪丸思考著從石頭得知的神祕座標之謎。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #10
programme.desc: 菲娜一行人順利解開石頭之謎,找出伊甸所在地。她為了面對自身與佛蘭茲留下的謎團,抵達座標標示的無人島。從未見過的神祕景色讓一行人嘆為觀止。這裡是否就是約定之地伊甸?

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 袁偉豪與太太張寶兒接力出行，「跟團」遊潮汕。潮州人愛喝功夫茶，袁生、袁太也要感受茶道魅力，怎料引發兩口子的小吵鬧情趣。二人又體驗喫茶聽戲觀賞潮劇，還解鎖人生的打賞成就。品嚐潮州地道特色粿品，偉豪何以自認食家？好勝寶兒對壘偷步偉豪，手做紅桃粿比拼結果如何？夜遊汕頭小公園，「大糖蔥薄餅 」令人找回兒時回憶；偉豪竟鬥膽在老婆面前「撩女仔」！回到酒店，兩人分享旅行喜好，偉豪還藉機向愛妻「賣口乖」。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 偉豪駕駛電單車載寶兒欣賞南澳島沿岸風光，並到訪文青咖啡店。獅頭鵝是潮汕名物，袁氏伉儷享用一席全鵝宴，一個鵝頭就逾千元！「打冷」亦是潮遊不可錯過的行程，寶兒化身賢內助為丈夫剝蝦殼。袁生、袁太來到活化自百年建築的茶樓飲早茶，再由旅遊達人帶路享用潮州私房菜，花膠、鮑魚等名貴菜式放滿一桌。走在汕尾的步道上，寶兒提出對望四分鐘的挑戰。怎料望着望着，她卻流下淚水，這時偉豪拿出一份記錄了兩人滿滿回憶的禮物……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#70粵
programme.desc: 義要揭發安殺人證據，但「藏屍皮箱」只是收藏大的芒果，安的神祕舉動只為話劇表演。眾人決定替安的家大翻新，更送出名貴電器以表陪罪。義接到大客需為員工投保的消息，立即命安等撰寫計劃書，但安竟偷拍下機密資料。

programme.title: 尚食#10粵普
programme.desc: 孟尚食被太子妃免去職位，她不明白王司膳為何落井下石，胡司膳道出原因；孟紫澐成為雜役，被月華批評她不知尊卑；太孫妃知道和太孫和子衿琴簫合奏，特地讓子衿送膳食及陪下棋，瞭解她的為人。

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 中國人愛「好意頭」，在農曆新年均喜愛貼上揮春、剪紙等傳統裝飾。隨着科技進步，人手書寫的揮春逐漸被電腦打印取代，但書法家「華戈」仍堅持即席揮毫。華戈曾為不少電影、廣告等題字，大家認得哪些是他的手筆嗎？看似簡單的剪紙，原來隱藏着不少奧妙之處。剪紙藝術家李雲俠示範剪羊時，何以會多剪一個風車作花紋？除了賀年裝飾，汕尾的「菜茶」亦被列入非物質文化遺產清單，香港廣東汕尾市同鄉總會會長詳述與菜茶有關的歷史。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 蟶子到！兩斤蟶子可怎樣烹調？鼎爺把部份蟶子開邊，連同冬瓜滾湯，剩下的蟶子原隻下鑊炒，再搭配原粒豉椒，鮮味昇華。準備好透明瓶子，還有預留兩日時間，一同醃豆角。把豆角繞着辣椒，外表夠特別，味道方面為何又要青檸又要醋，再加冰糖及粗鹽？話梅酸豆角醃法又怎樣？醃豆角除了單獨作小喫，還可融入一盆材料豐富的蟹肉冷麵，品嚐者必定大感滿足。青瓜竟然只要外皮不要肉？有人愛在冷麵上同時加麻醬及花生醬，阿爺卻只偏好麻醬！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症是香港頭號殺手，幸而治療方法越來越成熟，而放射治療亦分遠、近？臨牀腫瘤科醫生細說二者分別。此外，標靶放射治療是如何做到精準打擊癌細胞？入行五十載的文雪兒到臨，暢談深刻點滴。雪兒姐已是五個外孫的婆婆，現時其生活作息怎樣？其實雪兒姐的人生也曾遇過一些波浪，包括得悉自己患上乳癌，她作為「過來人」訴說經歷和當時心境，藉以鼓勵正受挫折的人士。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅巧製創意菜式「焦糖菠蘿咖啡排骨」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 「海上絲綢之路」三大港口之一的樟木古港，是粵東一個重要港口，祖藍這集在所屬的澄海區探尋美食。首站是每碗只售十元人民幣的豬腳飯，老闆堅持選豬腳定要夠新鮮，也夠信心推薦不嫌製作「麻煩」的豬腳趾，滷肉最少要花三小時，究竟有多滋味？還建議加五元配蠔仔湯，特別解膩！講起解膩，以五穀雜糧與刨冰奇妙融合的冰粥，想必可做到清爽又解暑。到訪當地祠堂，與某大家庭一起「喫桌」，祖藍的二嬸還從東莞前來，一齊品嚐豐富宴席！

programme.title: 五味人生#2粵
programme.desc: 雙春被若嵐襲擊，九妹替她不值，令雙春憶起因何嫁入關家……雙春被批發海鮮的貨商追欠款，只得請求延期。永禎被旅館老闆懷疑身分，正盤算另覓居所時，聽到有錢人任老闆將回鎮祭祖，於是在鎮長前冒認任老闆的代理人。同是經營酒樓的關照仁與關照義與海鮮貨商見面，想藉機讓雙春出賣酒樓；若嵐意外發現雙春收藏的金器首飾……雙春發現若嵐將自己的金器變賣後買入一堆無用的東西，不禁責罵若嵐；雙春為取回西服，當街打暈永禎……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: TRIGGER在 Next Re:vale前監製暗中幫助下，逐漸獲得電視臺工作。IDOLiSH7和Re:vale與電視臺人員開會共享《Friends Day》細節，事後移師百家裡進行內部會議，就了的破壞行動商討對策。百千萬三人喝酒談天，分享各自內心的想法。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 過往都由代為管理零食廠的話事人主理「廠長話」遊戲，蚌蚌公主這次將考官重任讓給團長Tiffany姐姐。Tiffany發出連串指令，某小兵於熱身賽三次出錯，到正式淘汰賽可會令人刮目相看？推地壺收集食材任務，啫喱隊、布甸隊對力度的控制似有不少差距。雙方合共收集到四款食材，蚌蚌公主仍對兩隊的表現感滿意。在「溶化之橋」上運送雪糕球不容易，有小兵踏出第三步就已弄跌雪糕。兩隊都採取先進取後保守的策略，成績如何？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐指出蜻蛉打的並非高爾夫球，因她沒感受過壓力。五十嵐嘗試讓蜻蛉體會何謂壓力，最後反而認輸，決家讓她保留真我。五十嵐想帶蜻蛉離開島上，他知道一般方法行不通，決定轉換思考方式。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 血友病是一種遺傳性凝血功能障礙疾病，因缺乏某類型凝血因子，導致受傷後血液不易凝固、長時間出血，或關節、肌肉自發性出血。該病多數女性為基因攜帶者，但極少發病，主要以影響男性為主。現時治療方法，主要是依靠終身定期或按需要時，靜脈注射缺失的凝血因子濃縮物，以防止受傷流血不止以及嚴重的關節病變。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 節目早前報道，柴灣某公屋有婦人將廚餘拋出窗外餵雀，雖曾承諾停止，但報料觀眾指她只是改變餵飼方式。車主的車輛正停泊在停車場中，卻收到電子告票，顯示其車在數十公里外違反交通規例。他向警方查詢，懷疑是警員誤記車牌所致。有酒樓推出名為「糧票」的預售券，卻遭職員藉此牟利，以糧票代客人結賬再收取現金，賺取中間差額。事主向公司揭發，怎料涉事同事仍照常上班，但事主卻疑因此被辭退……另送上《中年好聲音4》節目花絮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2780粵

programme.desc: 成彬被淑樺送離香港，加上警方連日搜索不果，Lydia的失蹤成為懸案。女學生文靜宜用美工刀割傷男教師張一匯，被控傷人，但她聲稱一匯企圖非禮。事件已導致一匯被停職、女友與他分手；惠知卻對兩名同學的證言有所懷疑，破天荒要求檢控官雅晴傳召全班三十名同學作證，終查明背後還另有隱情……接連的少年案件真相，思義有所反思，並希望修補與兒子洪知行的關係。少年趙世孝與樓宇住客口角後懷恨，為泄心頭之憤，竟然放火燒屋！

programme.title: 大生意人#2粵普

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 四川人會把鹹蛋開洞釀入糯米，製成地道美食糯米蛋，還曾風行全國。世韜師傅亦以糯米飯為材料，並融入廣東春捲特色，帶來變奏版菜式「脆皮糯米飯」。外層酥脆、內裡軟糯，再加上臘味、冬菇、瑤柱等惹味配料，層次豐富。北方人愛喫餃子，遼寧作為東北三省之一，當地人更以盛產的海腸、海膽入饌，製成餃子的餡料。紫欣以此做參考，結合西式烹調技巧，送上「海膽帶子意大利餃子」。這道菜令永權不顧儀態試食，滋味程度可想而知。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#40粵
programme.desc: (大結局)王翦倒戈，嬴政重掌大權，故意講出自己真正身分，不韋險被氣死，嬴政再賜飲毒酒，不韋死不瞑目。嬴政將朱姬的兒子吊在廣場引嫪毐回來，再在朱二人面前殺其子，少龍欲救無從。廷芳自覺配不上少龍，留書出走，少龍向廷芳剖白愛意。嬴政以一半江山試探少龍，少龍不為所動。少龍帶二女等離開鹹陽城，赫見王翦率兵攔阻。少龍等返回烏家堡，即接報嬴政親率大軍來捉少龍，少龍吩咐眾人躲進趙雅的衣冠塚，自己則與嬴政同歸於盡。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症是香港頭號殺手，幸而治療方法越來越成熟，而放射治療亦分遠、近？臨牀腫瘤科醫生細說二者分別。此外，標靶放射治療是如何做到精準打擊癌細胞？入行五十載的文雪兒到臨，暢談深刻點滴。雪兒姐已是五個外孫的婆婆，現時其生活作息怎樣？其實雪兒姐的人生也曾遇過一些波浪，包括得悉自己患上乳癌，她作為「過來人」訴說經歷和當時心境，藉以鼓勵正受挫折的人士。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅巧製創意菜式「焦糖菠蘿咖啡排骨」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵

programme.title: 五味人生#2粵
programme.desc: 雙春被若嵐襲擊，九妹替她不值，令雙春憶起因何嫁入關家……雙春被批發海鮮的貨商追欠款，只得請求延期。永禎被旅館老闆懷疑身分，正盤算另覓居所時，聽到有錢人任老闆將回鎮祭祖，於是在鎮長前冒認任老闆的代理人。同是經營酒樓的關照仁與關照義與海鮮貨商見面，想藉機讓雙春出賣酒樓；若嵐意外發現雙春收藏的金器首飾……雙春發現若嵐將自己的金器變賣後買入一堆無用的東西，不禁責罵若嵐；雙春為取回西服，當街打暈永禎……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#70粵
programme.desc: 義要揭發安殺人證據，但「藏屍皮箱」只是收藏大的芒果，安的神祕舉動只為話劇表演。眾人決定替安的家大翻新，更送出名貴電器以表陪罪。義接到大客需為員工投保的消息，立即命安等撰寫計劃書，但安竟偷拍下機密資料。

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.title: 尚食#11粵普

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺先介紹各式懷舊零食，再以威化紙裹入蝦膠與蝦肉炮製「威化雲吞蝦」，香脆又美觀。鼎爺再製作「南棗四物核桃榚」，自家製作棗蓉加上足料核桃、麥芽糖、糯米粉。如何鑑定糖漿的稠度？切件後包上威化紙，精緻可口。糯米粟、超甜粟有何分別？鼎爺帶來自家版本的粟米肉粒飯，除了新鮮粟米、豬柳粒，還加入豆乾、甘筍粒、青椒粒等，口感豐富。「椒鹽粟米」的製作步驟繁複，留意鼎爺切粟米的技巧，粟米先蒸後炸再伴上椒鹽，超級惹味！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 患上脂肪肝不但削弱肝功能，更會增加患心肌梗塞與中風的風險。心臟科醫生提醒，肥胖、「三高」、不良生活習慣都是脂肪肝的高危因素，建議透過減重改善。大人也可能有ADHD？精神科醫生指這並非突然出現，只是學童階段症狀不顯著，因而未被察覺。專注力不足、衝動等症狀於成人ADHD如何呈現？此症甚至有機會引發酗酒、濫藥等成癮問題。醫生細述真實個案，並帶來治療詳情。「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅示範「胡椒汁煎焗星斑」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 想去濠江區，在汕頭市坐船過海就可到達，這區歷史悠久，既有古建築亦有老食店。先到傳統豆漿店食個平價早餐，地豆豆漿夠「地道」，薑薯又原來無薑味？近海食海，汕頭人嚐海鮮都特別挑剔，用墨魚卵加木薯粉造粿，祖藍推介定要蘸辣醬喫，炸油筷被祖藍喻為「潮式魚手指」？小鯊魚也是上桌食材之一！祖藍聞說濠江區有位七叔專賣炣飯，七叔竟要祖藍親手炮製？原來炣飯與炒飯相若，不過要夠足料才滋味！祖藍最終下了多少食材？

programme.title: 五味人生#3粵
programme.desc: 雙春質問若嵐有否被永禎欺騙，若嵐辯稱一切是自願。雙春欲設計讓永禎露出馬腳，可惜棋差一著被看穿。鎮長等人到大屋巴結永禎，而他指出如辦歡迎任老闆的宴會必需要洋酒。永禎到訪酒樓，向雙春推銷能把中國燒酒變成洋酒「掘爛地」（白蘭地）的藥丸。為令雙春中計，他不惜向照仁與照義說出雙春擁有大批洋酒。雙春為求永禎出讓神奇藥丸，慘被他當工人使喚。永禎與利是妹欲離鎮之際，遇上仇家大力；躲進任家少爺任勝天的汽車車尾箱……

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2781粵
programme.desc: Venus欲與Joe約會，對方卻因工作繁忙而推辭。張愛盈知悉後遂設法幫忙，讓Venus得以跟Joe單獨相處，並且顯得和他趣味相投、心有靈犀。二人出雙入對，愛盈伺機向天娥透露Venus的心意，天娥遂打算考驗她，並帶來多方面測試。Venus一一通過考驗，箇中卻另有內情。天娥本對她滿意，但其後態度突變，原來因對她一個無法逆轉的先天條件感不滿。愛盈卻想到一個可幫助Venus的解決方法……

programme.desc: 「秋月樓縱火案」中，律政司認為證據不足考慮撤控，光正為正義頂着壓力，主動提出擔任主控！然而，被告世孝的父親趙坤是惡勢力人士，為保護兒子而毀滅唯一證據，如今只剩下一個目擊證人，正是世孝的表姐薏冰。開庭當日，薏冰卻稱病缺席。光正到醫院欲勸說，遭趙坤的手下阻撓及恐嚇……惠知決意對抗惡勢力，要毫無悔意的世孝得到教訓。邵文於「兒童之家偽造文書案」，冷漠對待雅晴的更改控罪請求，卻對其他法官逢迎，令雅晴感不齒。

programme.desc: 平原和玉兒在戰場上穿梭，後被蒙古兵抓進營地。玉兒殺了西蒙小汗王，助王爺解困，被封為格格，平原和常四等人亦獲救。玉兒因平原有婚約在身而遭拒婚，大感失落。平原進山西時遭縣令捉拿，王天貴欲利用其整頓當舖。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 雲南西雙版納的兩段片中，分別介紹當地人在熱帶雨林活捉鮮蟹造蟹醬，還有與香茅相關的菜餚。小儀師傅靈機一觸，以港人喜好的避風塘方式，加入香茅炮製「香茅避風塘軟殼蟹」。生蒜、炸蒜皆有，纔是呈現避風塘風味的關鍵！從片段觀摩大連蝦醬的製法，家鋌師傅還補充它可以即食，喫出鮮味。他這次選用新鮮小海蝦配上龍蝦湯等，並從剝蝦殼開始示範，為祖儀可在家造「自家蝦醬」提供指引。祖儀卻似乎不時以無聊發問，來打斷師傅的用心！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#1粵PG
programme.desc: 寮屋居民不滿政府清拆寮安排，激進居民阿力脅持孕婦與警方對恃，警方談判小組組長彭國棟及資深談判專家簡潔到場協助。國棟發揮其談判的專長將事件平息。國棟父彭大福生日於自己開設的菜館慶祝，貴利突上門追收國棟兄彭國富的賭債，國棟及妻潘文靜至，將貴利驅走。巡邏警員楊光仰慕簡潔，一次行動中，楊光遇簡潔、國棟二人，要求簡潔簽名留念，國棟認為他油腔滑調並無好感。在一次談判專家招募中，簡潔邀楊光投考。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 患上脂肪肝不但削弱肝功能，更會增加患心肌梗塞與中風的風險。心臟科醫生提醒，肥胖、「三高」、不良生活習慣都是脂肪肝的高危因素，建議透過減重改善。大人也可能有ADHD？精神科醫生指這並非突然出現，只是學童階段症狀不顯著，因而未被察覺。專注力不足、衝動等症狀於成人ADHD如何呈現？此症甚至有機會引發酗酒、濫藥等成癮問題。醫生細述真實個案，並帶來治療詳情。「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅示範「胡椒汁煎焗星斑」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 想去濠江區，在汕頭市坐船過海就可到達，這區歷史悠久，既有古建築亦有老食店。先到傳統豆漿店食個平價早餐，地豆豆漿夠「地道」，薑薯又原來無薑味？近海食海，汕頭人嚐海鮮都特別挑剔，用墨魚卵加木薯粉造粿，祖藍推介定要蘸辣醬喫，炸油筷被祖藍喻為「潮式魚手指」？小鯊魚也是上桌食材之一！祖藍聞說濠江區有位七叔專賣炣飯，七叔竟要祖藍親手炮製？原來炣飯與炒飯相若，不過要夠足料才滋味！祖藍最終下了多少食材？

programme.title: 五味人生#3粵
programme.desc: 雙春質問若嵐有否被永禎欺騙，若嵐辯稱一切是自願。雙春欲設計讓永禎露出馬腳，可惜棋差一著被看穿。鎮長等人到大屋巴結永禎，而他指出如辦歡迎任老闆的宴會必需要洋酒。永禎到訪酒樓，向雙春推銷能把中國燒酒變成洋酒「掘爛地」（白蘭地）的藥丸。為令雙春中計，他不惜向照仁與照義說出雙春擁有大批洋酒。雙春為求永禎出讓神奇藥丸，慘被他當工人使喚。永禎與利是妹欲離鎮之際，遇上仇家大力；躲進任家少爺任勝天的汽車車尾箱……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#71粵
programme.desc: 義決定自行撰寫計劃書，意外破壞了安奸計。安再向情下手時，溢揭發他玩弄感情的惡行，眾怒責，令本欲罷手的安與有情分手。義的計劃書竟與別家一樣。上司Margaret懷疑有義兄妹出賣公司利益，竟勒令二人停職。

programme.title: 尚食#11粵普
programme.desc: 朱棣不顧眾臣及太子勸阻，率兵北征，並與朱瞻基約定戰事結束後一起去狩獵，但不久就傳來朱棣死去的消息，眾妃嬪須陪葬，當中包括莊妃。子衿和紫萍特地為莊妃做核桃酪，以送她最後一程，但莊妃說味道與家鄉的不一樣…

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 鄭少秋、汪明荃召集王馨平、葉振棠、區瑞強、陳美玲、陳廸匡等老牌唱將，獻唱各自的首本金曲。幾位「靚聲」的名字一齣，<別問我是誰、<戲劇人生、<陌上歸人、<欲斷難斷等耳熟能詳的旋律便已飄過耳際……

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#72粵
programme.desc: 義及情被停職。義帶情到對手「日進保險」公司理論，竟揭發安是該公司的太子爺！情失落閒蕩卻遇上連串好事，但一切皆是安的補償。情主動往找安，更說明早已原諒他，但請他澄清有關義的嫌疑，這時義及溢卻出現大鬧安。

programme.title: 尚食#12粵普
programme.desc: 莊妃殉葬，宮中眾人不免兔死狐悲。朱高熾登基為帝，有意還都南京，又更改先帝所定國策，太子瞻基規勸。胡尚食在太子妃面前揭開姚子衿的身世，想捏造罪名陷害子衿，被瞻基救下。在瞻基追問下，子衿道出她入宮的目的。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 龍脷葉有助清熱，鼎爺親自採摘這種草藥，煲出滋潤的「雪梨龍脷葉沙參湯」。雪梨要切走芯去除澀味，連皮食用還能更有益！厴仔蟹肉嫩殼薄，用來烹調「鹽焗蝦蟹煲」容易入味。天使蝦較薄身，鹽焗前宜用紗紙包好避免過鹹。炮製油器講究功夫，主持們細談箇中手藝。釀鯪魚的配搭多變，「鬼馬釀鯪魚」更有兩種喫法！鼎爺將鯪魚肉等材料釀入油條內，炸出香脆口感；另會用鯪魚骨、鯪魚頭煲湯，放入略為炸過的鯪魚油條同煮，又是另一番滋味！

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 美國新發佈一份飲食指南，可謂顛覆固有食物金字塔的理念，着重選喫原型食物、摒除加工食品；除此以外，還有甚麼改變？心臟科醫生指，重點是要分清哪些是「好碳水化合物」和「好蛋白質」。跑步可增強心肺功能，減低慢性疾病風險，也有人提到跑步傷膝，易致退化性關節炎。跑步傷膝的說法孰真孰假？物理治療師詳細解說，並強調運動量與姿勢較為重要，還會示範幾個有助強化關節的動作。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「韓風辣炒豬肉鮮魷」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍逗留汕頭這段日子，已習慣當地的飲食習慣，要夠新鮮！前往海島南澳，當然要在海邊即捕即煮，準備好「趕海」的工具，把生蠔、螺、帶子都夾起來，再放進高壓鍋烹調，隨即新鮮享用。島上亦有田園風味的農家菜席，並由老闆娘親自介紹多款小菜，包括窯雞、燜排骨、鹹菜苦瓜、炒通菜等，一碗「生津藤雞湯」有何功效令祖藍要連湯帶渣喝掉？入夜後在地攤親自炒冰，祖藍試過後才知一杯炒冰也極花時間與力量，但自己炒的東西也特別美味！

programme.title: 五味人生#4粵
programme.desc: 勝天坐車入鎮時因肚瀉要求之科停車到草叢方便。永禎躲過追捕更乘機取去勝天留在車上的皮包……永禎被雙春等捉迴向他追討騙款。勝天因汽車死火而獨個走到鎮上卻身無分文，竟搶了村童的砵仔糕充饑，又不慎看到正寬衣洗澡的金鳳，給痛毆後收押在牢房。永禎乘九妹睡著欲離開時卻中了他先前佈下的「機關」……雙春要求永禎工作，當他送外賣到警署時，發現再次被捉回牢房的勝天，成功助勝天逃走帶往義莊匿藏；勝天感激，兩人更稱兄道弟。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 了原安排環的父親在節目最後醉酒鬧事，幸而一切早被百和千識穿，兩人將計就計讓IDOLiSH7在主會場唱歌。一織要求陸以後讓他控制，陸欣然答允。IDOLiSH7唱出TRIGGER的《SECRET NIGHT》，陸發揮其訴求力，現場觀眾反應熱烈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的動作有一定難度，大家宜按照自身能力，選擇做基本版還是進階版。先針對下肢肌力展開訓練，半蹲、站起循環做是基本動作，想增加難度可試試站立時踮腳尖。原地跳起也是常見練習，若雙腳跳起同時空中曲膝，連續做十二下又應付得來嗎？下一節鍛練主要圍繞核心肌羣，做出平板支撐的姿勢，雙腳前後移動。躺下，用核心力量帶動雙腳抬起，並坐直身體，甚至站起來，教練卻發覺大家都有「作弊」？

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 聖誕將至，美月因父母在海外工作，原本打算去祖父母的別墅度假，但聽說今年爸爸媽媽能回來，讓她興奮不已。接著，陽葵與美月便參加由學生會舉辦的聖誕派對，正當大家在雪地盡情玩耍，美月卻收到一個壞消息。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港是壓力城市，過去有調查顯示，大部分的受訪者覺得自有壓力，主要壓力來源是來自工作，至於減壓方法最多人會選擇做運動、購物、睡覺和看電視，亦有人會完全不理會自己的壓力問題。新聞掏寶和大家重溫2002年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2782粵
programme.desc: 樹根的衣服不慎跌進陳生居所，被陳生兄妹弄污。兩人事後仍若無其事地前往熊家借用豉油，樹仁憤而趕走他們，樹根卻反指樹仁不對。眾人奇怪樹根何以甘願借豉油給陳師奶，甚至她不在時仍對陳生兄妹百般容忍，遂設法逼他吐露真相。樹根終於揭開豉油的祕密，箇中涉及陳師奶年輕時與豉油廠少東一段不為人知的戀情，兩人慘遭拆散鴛鴦，陳師奶對少東所贈的豉油珍而重之，詎料……眾人擔心陳家的「豉油債、債不完」，尚善遂提出解決方法……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#9粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知繼續審理「秋月樓縱火案」，向來果斷的她卻一反常態，拖延判刑日期……此案告一段落，只有光正看穿惠知的用意。「兒童之家偽造文書案」續審，邵文依法判決，但他並非如表面般冷酷無情；雅晴意外得知後，對邵文改觀。光正被少女梁安娜潑一身紅油，源於她的母親因醫療事故離世，但涉事醫生獲律政司撤控。惠知與光正合作調查，揭發背後牽涉更多利益關係……天雪因生母的冷漠背棄而心靈受創，本想求助惠知，二人卻失諸交臂……

programme.title: 大生意人#4粵普
programme.desc: 為救常四，平原做了王天貴當舖泰裕豐的四掌櫃，卻遭排擠。一大漢來典當，平原成功化解難題，三個老朝奉便以請辭威脅來趕走他。於是平原找李欽合作，幫他的萬源當打響名號，百姓紛紛去泰裕豐贖回物品轉到萬源當典當。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 四川人愛喫麻辣菜式，家鋌師傅瞭解當地名菜棒棒雞後，決定用三黃雞與竹絲雞炮製「口水鴛鴦雞卷」，同樣香辣惹味！將兩種雞肉捲成卷狀，一口即可品嚐不同層次口感。透過片段，祖儀發現北方人偏愛以公雞入饌，師傅為她解釋中國南北方喫雞習慣的差異。西安大廚展身手，重現源自唐朝的佳餚；小儀師傅則以鹹魚這非遺食材煮芥蘭。過程中，她提到廚房術語之餘，還分享入廚知識。要令焯菜更翠綠，除了加糖外，下鍋時機亦十分關鍵。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#2粵PG
programme.desc: 一超市開幕，老闆楊孝文邀藝人剪綵引起混亂，楊光與同僚暴龍經過，成功控制場面；楊光遇叔父而被揭穿是該集團太子爺身份，暴龍愕然。文靜幫國富求情向國棟借錢還賭債，國富感激。國棟、文靜、簡潔及家聰相約郊遊，國棟大談與文靜的生育計劃，惟文靜還未有此打算。簡潔邀文靜到畫室工作卻遭國棟拒絕。楊光非有志做談判專家，但不想拒絕簡潔好意，只好參加面試。期間楊光遇同一警署工作的葉可人，楊光表現鎮定，可人卻因緊張而失準。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 美國新發佈一份飲食指南，可謂顛覆固有食物金字塔的理念，着重選喫原型食物、摒除加工食品；除此以外，還有甚麼改變？心臟科醫生指，重點是要分清哪些是「好碳水化合物」和「好蛋白質」。跑步可增強心肺功能，減低慢性疾病風險，也有人提到跑步傷膝，易致退化性關節炎。跑步傷膝的說法孰真孰假？物理治療師詳細解說，並強調運動量與姿勢較為重要，還會示範幾個有助強化關節的動作。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「韓風辣炒豬肉鮮魷」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍逗留汕頭這段日子，已習慣當地的飲食習慣，要夠新鮮！前往海島南澳，當然要在海邊即捕即煮，準備好「趕海」的工具，把生蠔、螺、帶子都夾起來，再放進高壓鍋烹調，隨即新鮮享用。島上亦有田園風味的農家菜席，並由老闆娘親自介紹多款小菜，包括窯雞、燜排骨、鹹菜苦瓜、炒通菜等，一碗「生津藤雞湯」有何功效令祖藍要連湯帶渣喝掉？入夜後在地攤親自炒冰，祖藍試過後才知一杯炒冰也極花時間與力量，但自己炒的東西也特別美味！

programme.title: 五味人生#4粵
programme.desc: 勝天坐車入鎮時因肚瀉要求之科停車到草叢方便。永禎躲過追捕更乘機取去勝天留在車上的皮包……永禎被雙春等捉迴向他追討騙款。勝天因汽車死火而獨個走到鎮上卻身無分文，竟搶了村童的砵仔糕充饑，又不慎看到正寬衣洗澡的金鳳，給痛毆後收押在牢房。永禎乘九妹睡著欲離開時卻中了他先前佈下的「機關」……雙春要求永禎工作，當他送外賣到警署時，發現再次被捉回牢房的勝天，成功助勝天逃走帶往義莊匿藏；勝天感激，兩人更稱兄道弟。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#72粵
programme.desc: 義及情被停職。義帶情到對手「日進保險」公司理論，竟揭發安是該公司的太子爺！情失落閒蕩卻遇上連串好事，但一切皆是安的補償。情主動往找安，更說明早已原諒他，但請他澄清有關義的嫌疑，這時義及溢卻出現大鬧安。

programme.title: 尚食#12粵普
programme.desc: 莊妃殉葬，宮中眾人不免兔死狐悲。朱高熾登基為帝，有意還都南京，又更改先帝所定國策，太子瞻基規勸。胡尚食在太子妃面前揭開姚子衿的身世，想捏造罪名陷害子衿，被瞻基救下。在瞻基追問下，子衿道出她入宮的目的。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 在維多利亞島某餐廳，結帳前做甚麼可獲免費？為何清萊女士在等大象排便？Do姐向黎耀祥、江美儀發問，還給予大量提示，被美儀反過來指責！Do姐選擇沉默，卻令陸永與祥仔想通了答案，猜出臺北拉麵店內用具的用途。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 森美、陳敏之在Do姐面前激鬥，爭奪享用官燕的機會！森美就像先知，對韓國喫炸雞文化瞭如指掌，相反敏之顯現無知的一面，C君又被指幫不上忙，勝負顯而易見！Do姐帶來一瓶孕婦爭相搶食的沙律醬，內有甚麼乾坤？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》樸荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視臺EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神祕事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 淘氣鼠兄弟全新一季！鼠兄弟莫圖、蘭布、喬圖，和小狗小唐之間吵吵鬧鬧的歡樂故事，再度展開！這次，鼠兄弟們又會想出什麼整人的新點子呢？

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》樸荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.desc: When a violinist is found murdered near da Vinci’s tomb in a pose similar to The Vitruvian Man, Captain Alban Dutertre returns home to investigate. As more da Vinci-inspired killings follow, he and Bérénice Amarillo link this to a missing young artist.

programme.title: The Kiss
programme.desc: In 1913 Denmark, young officer Anton grapples with duty and love when he befriends Baron von Løvenskjold's daughter, Edith, confined to a wheelchair. As their bond deepens, Anton is ensnared in a web of promises and lies, torn between pity and true love.

programme.title: Red, White And Brass
programme.desc: In a bid to sneak into the Tonga vs France rugby match, superfan Maka invents a fake band to perform for the pre-game show. With the match coming soon, Maka and his friends have four weeks to come up with a performance

programme.title: Temporaries
programme.desc: Ariane gets a job as an interpreter at a food plant after moving back to the Richelieu Valley following a breakup. There, she finds herself torn between obeying the harsh demands of her boss and standing up for the exploited migrant workers she befriends.

programme.title: I Am Dating You Not
programme.desc: Roberto loves Paula but she still can’t get over her ex-boyfriend. Meanwhile Roberto’s former girlfriend wants him back. Could office romance get more complicated? A romantic farce starring Virginia Rodríquez, Best Actress, Malaga Film Festival 2013.

programme.title: Catch The Wind
programme.desc: Edith is a middle-aged woman, estranged from her son and now about to lose her job as a textile factory worker. With nothing to hold her to her hometown, she decides to move to Morocco where her factory has relocated instead of facing unemployment.

programme.title: Silent Screams
programme.desc: A young doctor is confronted with bad cases of abused children. She is shocked at how complicated it is to hold parents accountable. When a baby is killed, she decides to take a more active role, risking her medical license and her own life.

programme.title: To Kill A Mongolian Horse
programme.desc: Saina, a herdsman by day and horseback performer by night, clings to his heritage on the wintry steppes of Inner Mongolia, as he’s forced to confront the crumbling of the world he once knew.

programme.title: èreMurder in the Finist
programme.desc: When a storm fells a sacred oak in Brittany, Captain Morgane Ledantec uncovers human bones tied to a druidic past she once shared. As Morgane’s buried gift of foresight resurfaces, she must confront old friends hiding secrets of their own.

programme.title: My Killer Buddy
programme.desc: Denni is 10 years old and has a mission, to save his mother from his father’s violence. For this reason he devises an infallible plan: he will have him killed by someone who kills people for a living, a super-killer.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. The Squirrels take an epic journey to give it back.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save a family of mountain gorillas from traps left by hunters and also from a sneezy Grandmaster Glitch's germs.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Chilli sets up an obstacle course in the backyard, but Bluey is disheartened when Bandit turns it into a race and beats her. After cheating in a rematch, Bluey discovers the importance of training in order to improve her skills.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Common Octopus
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his safari-sub to the coast of South Africa in search of an octopus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Gloves
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Honey Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Tadpole Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Kite Badge
programme.desc: It's a very windy day and the squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Tower Bridge, London
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir hat. But he's run out of pocket money, so he decides to earn some as a tour guide.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Panama Canal, Panama
programme.desc: Glitch sinks in the Panama Canal and needs saving... again.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Crowning Around
programme.desc: Rajiv feels devastated when he loses his crown, thinking that it's the reason he is good at anything, but he soon learns that can still be really useful.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Mouse's Birthday
programme.desc: Sarah's hoping for a nice quiet birthday, but there's no chance once her friends arrive.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Ribbon Fall
programme.desc: The Ribbon Sisters invite Sarah and Duck to their favourite seasonal event in the park.

programme.desc: The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save a family of mountain gorillas from traps left by hunters and also from a sneezy Grandmaster Glitch's germs.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Chilli sets up an obstacle course in the backyard, but Bluey is disheartened when Bandit turns it into a race and beats her. After cheating in a rematch, Bluey discovers the importance of training in order to improve her skills.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Common Octopus
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his safari-sub to the coast of South Africa in search of an octopus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Gloves
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Honey Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Tadpole Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Kite Badge
programme.desc: It's a very windy day and the squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Tower Bridge, London
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir hat. But he's run out of pocket money, so he decides to earn some as a tour guide.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Panama Canal, Panama
programme.desc: Glitch sinks in the Panama Canal and needs saving... again.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S23) - Crowning Around
programme.desc: Rajiv feels devastated when he loses his crown, thinking that it's the reason he is good at anything, but he soon learns that can still be really useful.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Mouse's Birthday
programme.desc: Sarah's hoping for a nice quiet birthday, but there's no chance once her friends arrive.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Ribbon Fall
programme.desc: The Ribbon Sisters invite Sarah and Duck to their favourite seasonal event in the park.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Dinosaur
programme.desc: The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Go Stargazing

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Traffic Badge

programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time

programme.desc: The Teletubbies take it in turns to go up and down on the Dup Dup. Sometimes they go fast and sometimes they go slow - even The Noo-­‐noo has a turn!

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Beetle Mania
programme.desc: When an alien beetle infestation threatens to expose their true identities, the Royals must depend on a new ally for help. Meanwhile, Zadra joins Morando’s army as a double agent who secretly spies on him for the growing Resistance.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Collision Course
programme.desc: Aja and Krel's search for parts to repair the Mothership leads them to Driver's Ed -- and a high speed run-in with the Zeron Brotherhood. Meanwhile, Zadra begins spying on Morando's sinister plans.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - D'aja Vu
programme.desc: Stuck in a time-loop, Aja finds unlikely help from Jim Lake and Team Trollhunters. Meanwhile, a giant Troll rampages the Arcadia High Science Fair, threatening to expose both the Troll world and Aja and Krel’s alien secret.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Born a Toretto
programme.desc: 17-year-old Tony Toretto and his gang are psyched when Dom recommends them to Ms. Nowhere for a spy racing job. Excited to get the opportunity to live up to Dom’s legacy, they use their street smarts and driving skills to infiltrate a race with SH1FT3R, a high-octane racing circuit whose drivers are all under 20.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites. Tony’s awesome driving impresses Shashi Dhar (the head of SH1FT3R and the person Ms. Nowhere wants them to investigate), and after Tony and his crew pull a heist on a big rig full of energy drinks for Shashi, they’re officially accepted into the circuit.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ghost Town Grand Prix
programme.desc: Tony races against Shashi and Layla through a Northern California ghost town, but Shashi and Layla are using the race as a cover for a heist on a billionaire’s train. Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Owl Job
programme.desc: Shashi sends Tony and Layla to steal weapons codes from a Russian oligarch, while Margaret "Echo" Pearl, Cisco and Frostee use Shashi’s absence to sneak into Shashi’s Cliffside mansion to investigate. Ms. Nowhere tells the team to look for the "keys" in Shashi’s mansion, but all they find are a couple of awesome super-cars.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Celestial Vault
programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Rhino Charges
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Rhino didn't charge and he couldn't see very well at all. Poor old Rhino really wanted to be invited to the Dance of the Horns up on the plains with Buffalo and all the other horned animals. But Rhino didn't have a horn, so he wasn't allowed. The Monkeys decide to help Rhino and make him a horn from a piece of old wood. But when Rhino wakes up he doesn't know what it is. ‘Aargh! Thing on the end of my nose! CHAAaarge!' And that's Why Rhino Charges.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Caterpillar Is Never In A Hurry
programme.desc: You see Caterpillar was never in a hurry. When all the animals were racing around Tinga Tinga getting ready for the Best-dressed parade, Caterpillar was happy to sit in a tree and munch on leaves saying ‘Po-le, po-le, slowly, slowly, good things come to those who wait'. Then one day the rains come and Caterpillar disappears into a cocoon. ‘What's happening?' questions Elephant. ‘Wait and see' says Tortoise wisely ‘Wait and See'.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Flying Shark
programme.desc: Julian is very excited about the Sealife Awareness Day at Greendale School. While he's talking to Pat about it, his dad gets a call from Ben - a special delivery! Pat discovers it's a giant inflatable shark which is to be the surprise centrepiece of the Sealife day. But when Pat stops to help Alf mend a gate, a mix-up with parcel tape ends up with the whale accidentally inflating and floating off...

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Blue Flash
programme.desc: Pat must deliver Ben to Greendale School, dressed as superhero, The Blue Flash. But Ben keeps stopping to help people on the way and his costume gets increasingly ruined! Meanwhile at the school, Julian can't wait to meet his hero but Sarah Gilbertson insists that The Blue Flash isn't real... At last Pat arrives at the school with Ben wearing a new costume hastily cobbled together by Pat. Julian isn't fooled. Looks like The Blue Flash isn't real after all...

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Mountain Mayhem Gator Spinner Max
programme.desc: After winning a citizen swap contest, Archibald moves to a mountain town for a week. Archibald finds a practical use for his pal's wacky invention.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Dino-Can-Do Big Bad Bug
programme.desc: Crackridge's new resident dinosaur has a hard time fitting in. Archibald and a new friend attempt to conquer their fear of the basement.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of Deltoid's Strange Behaviour
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is upset because her best friend, Deltoid, keeps calling her a monster and running away from her. Noddy decides to investigate and find out why Deltoid's behaving so strangely. He soon discovers that Deltoid has lost all his memories and doesn't recognise any of his friends anymore.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Slippery Stage
programme.desc: Pat-Pat is meant to be giving a baton twirling display at the Town Hall but the stage is covered with sticky stuff. Clockwork Mouse and Carlton can clear up the sticky stuff but Noddy must investigate to find out who was trying to spoil Pat-Pat's show or they might do it again! Using his wwwbook to follow all the clues from polishing day at the Fairy Castle to Fairy Coco swapping the polish for a ribbon, Noddy works out it was Pat-Pat who tried to delay her show.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Broken Toy Wash
programme.desc: Fuse is heartbroken when his new special toy wash is broken. Right before Revs could have a wash in it too! Noddy decides to investigate and help the little robot find out who has broken it. Using all his investigating skills and collecting evidence with the WhoWhatWhere Tablet Noddy realises that it's his own best beloved car, Revs, who broke the toy wash! Poor Revs thought that if he went through the toy wash he'd miss his special time with Noddy and Bumpy.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Dazzle Dragon
programme.desc: Everyone in Fable Fields is very worried that a new Dazzle Dragon has appeared in the land. Big Ears says there's no such thing as a Dragon in Toyland so Noddy decides to investigate.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - Bridge to Meowbuquerque No Part Harmony

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie.
